scripts.buildDevelopmentDatabases: docker build -f builds/docker/mysql/Dockerfile .  -t balek-mysqldb:develop && docker build -f builds/docker/mongo/Dockerfile .  -t balek-mongo:develop
scripts.startDevelopmentDatabases: docker compose -f builds/docker/mysql/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker compose -f builds/docker/mongo/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.stopDevelopmentDatabases: docker compose -f builds/docker/mysql/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f builds/docker/mongo/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.buildAll: npm run preBuild && npm run build && npm run postBuild
scripts.resetDevData: npm run removeOwnerDevice && npm run resetDevelopmentDatabase && npm run buildDevelopmentDatabases
scripts.resetProduction: npm run removeOwnerFileFromProduction && npm run resetProductionContainers && docker compose -f builds/digiscan/docker-compose.yml exec -T digiscan npm run showAdminDeviceInvitation

scriptsComments.buildDevelopmentDatabases: Uses Docker to build database containers for development
scriptsComments.startDevelopmentDatabases: Uses Docker to run database containers for development
scriptsComments.stopDevelopmentDatabases: Uses Docker to stop database containers for development
scriptsComments.buildDocumentation: Runs the script to build the docs
scriptsComments.showAdminDeviceInvitation: Shows the Owner Device information or QRcode to claim ownership. Include hostname as first argument
